about: Clifford Capital is a Singapore-based specialist finance company providing export credit, project finance and infrastructure and marine lending to companies, especially in Asia. Founded in 2012 with Temasek among its backers, it works with insurers and banks. Customers are corporates, shipping and infrastructure firms. The listed funding amount appears to be debt raised. B2B financial institution with low public brand awareness.
cb_desc: Clifford Capital is a company that provides overseas marine..

about: CloudWalk is a Brazilian fintech headquartered in Sao Paulo that operates the InfinitePay payments business and the JIM.com platform, offering card machines, digital accounts, credit and merchant services to small and medium businesses. Founded in 2013, it has raised well over 300 million dollars from investors including Valor Capital and Redpoint, with a valuation above 2 billion dollars. Revenue comes from transaction fees, credit and account services. Strong brand among Brazilian small merchants, expanding in Latin America and the US.

wiki.title: CloudWalk Technology
wiki.text: CloudWalk Technology Co. Ltd. is a Chinese developer of facial recognition software.

wiki.title: CloudWalk (company)
wiki.text: CloudWalk is a Brazilian financial technology company based in São Paulo. It is considered a unicorn. The company operates primarily in Brazil through the financial services platform InfinitePay, launched in 2019, and internationally through the payment app JIM.com, aimed at the North American market.

about: Qatar Islamic Bank (QIB) is Qatar's largest Islamic bank, headquartered in Doha and listed on the Qatar Stock Exchange (QIBK). It offers Sharia-compliant retail, corporate and wealth banking, with subsidiaries and affiliates abroad. Founded 1982, with the Qatari state and royals among shareholders. Strong national consumer brand and sponsor of sports and cultural events in Qatar.

Riyad Bank is one of Saudi Arabia's largest banks, headquartered in Riyadh and listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul). Founded 1957, it provides retail, corporate, treasury, Islamic and private banking through a network of branches and ATMs across the Kingdom, with international arms in London, Houston and Singapore and a stake in Riyad Capital. The Public Investment Fund and GOSI-linked institutions are major shareholders. Strong Saudi consumer brand and an active sponsor of football and sports events.

Saudi National Bank (SNB), headquartered in Jeddah, is Saudi Arabia's largest bank by assets, created in 2021 by the merger of National Commercial Bank (NCB) and Samba Financial Group. It provides retail, corporate, treasury, wealth and Sharia-compliant banking, with branches in Saudi Arabia and offshore operations. The Public Investment Fund holds around 37 percent. Listed on the Saudi Exchange. Strong consumer brand in the Kingdom, including football and event sponsorships such as the Saudi Pro League.

Ant Group is the Chinese fintech giant behind Alipay, headquartered in Hangzhou and affiliated with Alibaba founder Jack Ma. It operates a payments app used by over a billion people, plus wealth management (Fund Sales), credit (Huabei, Jiebei), insurance, MYbank and international payments such as Alipay+ and Ant International. Revenue is over 100 billion yuan. Spun from Alibaba in 2014; its 2020 IPO was halted by regulators. Privately held. Very strong consumer brand in China and widely used by Chinese tourists abroad.

wiki.title: Ant Group
wiki.text: Ant Group, formerly known as Ant Financial, is an affiliate company of the Chinese conglomerate Alibaba Group. Ant Group was initially the financial transaction arm of Alibaba, Alipay, when it was set up in 2004.

about: Banque Saudi Fransi (BSF) is a Saudi Arabian bank offering retail, corporate, treasury and investment banking, Islamic products, and brokerage through Alfransi Capital. Headquartered in Riyadh, it was established in 1977 as a joint venture, and French bank Credit Agricole has been a major shareholder. Customers are Saudi consumers and businesses, with assets of roughly 300 billion riyals. Listed on Tadawul (1050). Well-known banking brand in Saudi Arabia.

Bank Hapoalim is Israel's largest bank by assets, offering retail, business, corporate and private banking, capital markets and credit cards through branches and digital channels, with operations abroad. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, founded in 1921. Customers are Israeli consumers and businesses. Listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (POLI). Very strong domestic brand, with sports sponsorship in Israel.

Bank Leumi is one of Israel's two largest banks, providing retail, business, private and corporate banking, mortgages, capital markets and its Pepper digital bank, with global operations. Headquartered in Tel Aviv, founded in 1902. Customers are Israeli consumers and businesses. Listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (LUMI). Strong domestic consumer brand.

EQT is a Stockholm-based global investment firm running private equity, infrastructure, real estate, growth and venture funds, with about 270 billion euros in assets under management and portfolio companies across Europe, North America and Asia. Customers are institutional investors such as pension funds and sovereign funds, with revenue from management fees and carried interest. Founded in 1994 with roots in the Wallenberg family's Investor AB. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (EQT) since 2019. Well-known in finance, low consumer awareness.

Global Payments is a merchant payments technology company headquartered in Atlanta, offering card acceptance, point-of-sale software, issuer processing and commerce tools to millions of businesses and financial institutions worldwide. It merged with TSYS in 2019 and, in 2025, agreed to buy Worldpay while selling its Issuer Solutions business to FIS. Revenue is about $10 billion. Listed on NYSE (GPN). B2B brand, known in banking and retail, with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Global Payments
wiki.text: Global Payments Inc. is an American multinational financial technology company that provides payment technology to merchants, issuers and consumers. In June 2021, the company was named to the Fortune 500. The company processes payments made through credit cards, debit cards, and digital and contactless payments.

about: Saudi bank formed in 2019 when Saudi British Bank (SABB) merged with Alawwal Bank, headquartered in Riyadh and part-owned by HSBC. Provides retail, corporate, treasury and investment banking, with several hundred branches in Saudi Arabia and one of the country's larger loan books. Listed on Tadawul (1060). Established consumer banking brand in the Kingdom with limited international profile, relevant for Saudi-linked activations.

Enova International is a US online lending and fintech company that provides short-term credit, installment loans, lines of credit and small business financing under brands such as CashNet, NetCredit, OnDeck and Headway Capital. Customers are non-prime consumers and small businesses, and it uses proprietary analytics for underwriting. Founded in 2004 as part of Cash America, spun out in 2014; headquartered in Chicago and listed on the NYSE (ENVA). Reports around 3 billion dollars of annual revenue, largely in the United States and Brazil. Moderate brand awareness among consumers who borrow.

Mizrahi Tefahot Bank is Israel's third-largest bank by assets, headquartered in Tel Aviv, specialising in mortgages and retail banking and serving households, businesses and institutions. It is listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (MZTF) and controlled by the Ofer family and other holders. Founded in 2004 through the merger of Mizrahi Bank and Tefahot. High consumer visibility in Israel, with a focus on housing finance and minimal overseas presence.

Scalapay is an Italian buy-now-pay-later fintech, founded in 2019 by Simone Mancini and Johnny Mitrevski, which lets shoppers split purchases into three or four interest-free instalments at online and in-store merchants in Italy, Spain, Germany, France and elsewhere. Merchants pay fees, and the Crunchbase HQ is shown as Dublin, with main operations in Milan. It has raised hundreds of millions of dollars in equity and debt. Known to Italian online shoppers, with some sports marketing.

eCapital is a Miami, Florida, commercial finance firm that provides factoring, asset-based lending and equipment finance to small and mid-sized businesses in North America, Europe and Latin America, and has grown through acquiring other factoring firms. It is backed by private equity. Funding shown is about 1.8 billion dollars, likely including debt facilities. B2B lender with little consumer brand awareness.

about: Garanti BBVA is one of Turkey's largest private banks, headquartered in Istanbul and majority-owned by Spain's BBVA. It provides retail, SME, corporate and digital banking, with several hundred branches, tens of millions of customers, and assets of the order of tens of billions of dollars. Listed on Borsa Istanbul (GARAN). It has long been a sponsor of Turkish sport and arts, and is a household brand in Turkey.

wiki.title: Garanti BBVA
wiki.text: Garanti BBVA is a Turkish financial services company based in Turkey. 86% of Garanti's stakes are owned by the Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA).

about: Intrum is a Stockholm-based credit management company that collects debts and buys non-performing loans for banks, telecom, utility and retail clients across about 20 European countries. It earns fees and returns on purchased portfolios, and has been listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. It carried heavy debt and completed a restructuring in 2024 to cut leverage and extend maturities. B2B, with a low and sometimes negative public profile among consumers.

Bridgit is an Australian privately owned non-bank lender, according to Crunchbase, based in Sydney, providing finance to borrowers outside traditional banks, and has recorded funding of about $1.3 billion, likely mostly debt facilities. Customers are likely property investors and small businesses. Revenue comes from interest and fees. It should not be confused with the Canadian construction software company Bridgit. Low public brand visibility. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: Bridgit is an Australian privately owned non-bank lender.

about: Plaid is a San Francisco financial technology company, founded in 2013, whose software lets consumers connect bank accounts to apps like Venmo, Robinhood and Coinbase, and supplies data, payments and identity services to developers and banks. It earns fees from companies using its API, and reached a valuation of about $6 billion after raising about $1.3 billion. Visa's 2020 $5.3 billion purchase was abandoned. B2B, but widely seen by consumers in the Plaid Link screen.

wiki.title: Plaid Inc.
wiki.text: Plaid Inc. is an American financial services company based in San Francisco, California. The company builds a data transfer network that powers fintech and digital finance products.

about: Talanx is a Hanover-based German insurance group, the parent of HDI and Hannover Re, one of the world's largest reinsurers. It offers industrial, retail and reinsurance cover in over 175 countries, and is listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (TLX). Premium income is in the tens of billions of euros. Retail brand HDI is known in Germany and Latin America; Talanx itself is mainly B2B.

wiki.title: Talanx
wiki.text: Talanx is a German multinational financial services company headquartered in Hanover, Germany. Its core businesses include reinsurance, insurance and asset management. Talanx is Germany's third-largest insurance group and one of the major European insurance groups by premium income. The group operates in more than 150 countries.

about: Tata Capital is a Mumbai-based Indian non-banking financial company in the Tata Group, offering consumer, commercial and infrastructure loans, wealth management and cards. It is a subsidiary of Tata Sons and was listed on the NSE and BSE in October 2025. Funding shown is about $914 million. Benefits from the strong Tata name in India and advertises to consumers.

Banco do Brasil is Brazil's largest bank by assets, majority state-owned by the federal government, headquartered in Brasilia, with retail, corporate, agribusiness and investment banking, and tens of millions of customers through thousands of branches. Founded in 1808, it is listed on the B3 exchange (BBAS3). One of the best-known consumer brands in Brazil and a long-time major sponsor of sport, notably volleyball and football.

wiki.title: Banco do Brasil
wiki.text: Banco do Brasil S.A. is a Brazilian financial services company headquartered in Brasília, Brazil. The oldest bank in Brazil, and among the oldest banks in continuous operation in the world, it was founded by John VI, King of Portugal, on Wednesday, 12 October 1808. It is the second largest banking institution in Brazil, as well as the second largest in Latin America. Banco do Brasil is controlled by the Brazilian government and is listed at the B3 stock exchange in São Paulo.

about: Ziraat Bank (Turkiye Cumhuriyeti Ziraat Bankasi) is Turkey's largest state-owned bank, headquartered in Ankara, with a branch network of over 1,700 and large retail, agricultural, SME and corporate banking, as well as international branches. Owned by the Turkey Wealth Fund, founded in 1863. A very well-known consumer bank in Turkey and a long-standing sponsor of Turkish sports, including football.

wiki.title: Ziraat Bank
wiki.text: Ziraat Bankası is a Turkish public bank founded in 1863. The bank provides commercial loan support to companies and tradesmen, as well as personal loans such as consumer loans, vehicle loans and housing loans.

about: Apollo PK AirFinance is a provider of loans secured by aircraft, serving airlines and lessors; the Crunchbase location is in Bavaria, Germany. It was a joint venture of Apollo Global Management and PK AirFinance (Germany and US). Total funding listed is about $1.6 billion. Beyond this, its current ownership and activity are not clear from the data available. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: ABN AMRO Bank is a Dutch bank based in Amsterdam, with retail, private and corporate banking and a strong position in the Netherlands, and around 20,000 employees. The Dutch state held a majority stake after a 2008 bail-out and has been reducing it, with shares on Euronext Amsterdam (ABN). In 2025 it agreed to buy NIBC. Recognisable Dutch consumer brand and long-time sponsor of events including tennis in Rotterdam.

wiki.title: ABN AMRO
wiki.text: ABN AMRO Bank N.V. is the third-largest Dutch bank, with headquarters in Amsterdam. It was initially formed in 1991 by merger of the two prior Dutch banks that form its name, Algemene Bank Nederland (ABN) and Amsterdamsche en Rotterdamsche Bank.
